0.0: Hello, #h0#. So, you want to know the secret to my sharp Insight? Thank you for the compliment, but there's no great secret at work here... I just happen to be fairy-born, and so my eyes are better than human eyes.
0.1: Fairy eyes aren't easily dazzled by flashy displays. I was born with such eyes, but I understand that some humans can train their eyes to be like this. I think you know the kind of training of which I speak...
0.2: Your Insight is not so different from mine. Don't believe me? Well, let's put it to the test, shall we?

yes.0: Are you familiar with the monsters called #r#o2230113#s#k which live in the forests of #m101000000#? Why don't you try defeating #r600#k of them? For you, this should be easy.

no.0: Of course. Your Insight is already fine without my help.

mob.0: Have you not defeated #r600 #o2230113##k monsters yet? This should be easy for you.

1.0: Have you defeated the #o2230113# monsters? I thought that it would be easy for you. You have insight powerful enough to resist any illusion. Your eyes aren't so different from a fairy's.
